item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
HS Reconnect 1.3.0

  • Added a local Solo Battlegrounds lobby overlay with public ranks, ratings, and an estimated lobby average.
  • Added Command-Shift-L positioning mode, proportional resizing, saved layout, and adjustable opacity.
  • Restores the last complete lobby after Hearthstone reconnects into the same match.
  • Added automatic and manual update checks.
  • Added an in-app bug report form with drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, previews, and up to five optional images.
  • Redesigned the main app and bug-report windows.
